project.name: airness-it
project.description:
The harness seen from a consumer's side of it. This module inherits airness-parent the way a real project does and carries no analysis configuration of its own, so a finding it reports came off the plugin classpath and nowhere else.
It is deliberately not a module of the airness build. A consumer inherits the parent rather than being built by it, and building this on its own is what makes it a test of inheritance rather than of aggregation. Run 'mvn clean package' here once the parent and the configuration jar are installed. A build that fails is the expected outcome: the sources violate rules on purpose, and the findings are the evidence the configuration resolved.
